components.name: Stacking Cards
components.description: Layered 3D sticky stack cards with progressive scroll depth scale decay and reverse scaling exit mechanics.

props.name: topStart
props.label: Top Start (px)
props.description: Offset in pixels from top of viewport for the first sticky card.

props.name: topIncrement
props.label: Top Increment (px)
props.description: Vertical stacking offset in pixels for each subsequent card.

props.name: cardGap
props.label: Card Gap (px)
props.description: Vertical gap in pixels between cards in normal flow before they stack.

props.name: scaleThreshold
props.label: Scale Threshold (px)
props.description: Scroll distance threshold over which progressive scaling activates.

props.name: minScale
props.label: Minimum Scale
props.description: Minimum scale applied to the base card in the stack.

props.name: reverseScale
props.label: Reverse Scale
props.description: Enable or disable reverse scaling exit cascade mechanics.

components.name: Horizontal Scroller
components.description: Pinned kinetic viewport camera that seamlessly translates horizontal cards in 1:1 synchronization with vertical page scroll (Brix Agency architecture).

props.name: itemGap
props.label: Card Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing in pixels between horizontal cards (default: 28px).

props.name: speed
props.label: Scroll Speed Multiplier
props.description: Scroll distance multiplier mapping vertical page scroll to horizontal translation distance.

props.name: cardWidth
props.label: Card Width (px)
props.description: Fixed card width in pixels (default: 320px).

props.name: showProgress
props.label: Progress Indicator
props.description: Display a kinetic telemetry progress bar indicating track traversal percentage.

props.name: showFadeEdges
props.label: Fade Edges
props.description: Show subtle gradient mask at horizontal boundaries for graceful card entry and exit.

props.name: fadeWidth
props.label: Fade Width (px)
props.description: Width in pixels of the left and right gradient fade masks.

props.name: fadeEdgeColor
props.label: Fade Edge Color
props.description: Custom edge gradient color. When empty, an alpha mask is used.

props.name: fadeEdgeColorDark
props.label: Fade Edge Color (Dark Mode)
props.description: Edge gradient color when dark mode is active. Falls back to fadeEdgeColor.

props.name: mobileMode
props.label: Mobile Mode
props.description: Mobile fallback behavior below 768px (scroll = native touch swipe with snap, stack = vertical list, pinned = retain pinned rail).

components.name: CSS Masonry
components.description: Pure CSS multi-column responsive masonry layout with zero external JavaScript runtime overhead.

props.name: columns
props.label: Mobile Columns (<640px)
props.description: Base column count on mobile viewports (<640px).

props.name: columnsSm
props.label: Tablet Columns (640-1024px)
props.description: Number of columns on tablet viewports (≥640px).

props.name: columnsMd
props.label: Medium Tablet Columns
props.description: Number of columns on medium tablet viewports.

props.name: columnsLg
props.label: Desktop Columns (1024-1280px)
props.description: Number of columns on desktop viewports.

props.name: columnsXl
props.label: Ultra-wide Columns (≥1280px)
props.description: Number of columns on large screens (≥1280px).

props.name: gap
props.label: Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between masonry columns and item margins.

props.name: columnFill
props.label: Column Fill
props.description: Controls whether column heights are balanced or filled sequentially.

props.name: height
props.label: Container Height (px)
props.description: Explicit container height for sequential waterfall (0 for auto balance).

components.name: Auto Grid
components.description: Responsive CSS Grid with auto-fit / auto-fill minmax repeat tracks with zero media queries.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.label: Min Width (px)
props.description: Minimum width of each grid column before wrapping to the next line.

props.name: gap
props.label: Grid Gap (px)
props.description: Gap between grid items.

props.name: mode
props.label: Track Mode
props.description: Determines whether tracks collapse to stretch items or stay fixed.

props.name: maxColumns
props.label: Max Columns
props.description: Upper constraint on maximum columns allowed.

props.name: alignItems
props.label: Item Alignment
props.description: Cross-axis vertical alignment for items within grid rows.

components.name: Tilt Card
components.description: Interactive 3D mouse-tracking card tilt with smooth gyroscopic physics, spring damping, and reverse mode.

props.name: maxTilt
props.label: Max Tilt (deg)
props.description: Maximum 3D tilt rotation in degrees at card boundary edges.

props.name: perspective
props.label: Perspective (px)
props.description: 3D perspective projection depth in pixels (lower = stronger foreshortening).

props.name: scale
props.label: Hover Scale
props.description: Card scale multiplier applied on pointer hover.

props.name: speed
props.label: Damping Speed
props.description: Kinetic spring lerp damping factor (higher = snappier, lower = smoother glide).

props.name: reverse
props.label: Reverse Tilt
props.description: Invert tilt direction (tilts towards cursor instead of sinking away).

props.name: disabled
props.label: Disabled
props.description: Programmatically disable 3D tilt tracking.

props.name: axis
props.label: Tilt Axis
props.description: Constrain tilt rotation axis (all = 3D pitch+yaw, x = pitch only, y = yaw only).

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: Dynamic 2D spatial coordinate tracking with sub-pixel radial border illumination mask and smooth exponential smoothing.

props.name: radius
props.label: Spotlight Radius (px)
props.description: Radius of the radial spotlight illumination in pixels.

props.name: color
props.label: Spotlight Color
props.description: Background radial sheen color (CSS color string or hex).

props.name: borderColor
props.label: Border Glow Color
props.description: Color of the illuminated border edge specular mask.

props.name: opacity
props.label: Glow Opacity
props.description: Opacity of the spotlight when cursor is active over the card.

props.name: spread
props.label: Falloff Spread (%)
props.description: Radial gradient falloff softness percentage.

props.name: mode
props.label: Spotlight Mode
props.description: Select whether to illuminate the border mask, background sheen, or both.

props.name: smoothing
props.label: Inertial Smoothing
props.description: Kinetic exponential smoothing response rate (1.0 = instant, 0.1 = silky inertia).

props.name: disabled
props.label: Disable Tracking
props.description: Programmatically disable pointer tracking and spotlight illumination.

components.name: Morphing Tabs
components.description: Dynamic active rect geometry tracking with a floating spring indicator and roving focus keyboard navigation.

props.name: springStiffness
props.label: Spring Stiffness (omega)
props.description: Natural angular frequency (omega) of the critically damped spring ODE.

props.name: variant
props.label: Indicator Variant
props.description: Visual style and geometry of the kinetic morphing indicator.

props.name: size
props.label: Tab Size
props.description: Padding and typographic scale of tab trigger buttons.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Zero-jank dynamic height disclosure using CSS Grid 0fr to 1fr interpolation with morphing plus/minus icon and clean theme elevation.

props.name: mode
props.label: Expansion Mode
props.description: Single auto-collapses previous items; multiple allows independent toggles.

props.name: collapsible
props.label: Collapsible
props.description: In single mode, allows closing the currently expanded item.

props.name: gap
props.label: Item Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between accordion items. 0 forms a seamless connected panel.

props.name: bordered
props.label: Bordered
props.description: Render items with crisp theme borders and active accent rings.

props.name: shadow
props.label: Shadow Elevation
props.description: Apply subtle depth shadow and hover elevation.

props.name: showNumbers
props.label: Index Badges
props.description: Display leading monospace index numbers (01, 02) before titles.

props.name: showIcon
props.label: Morphing Icon
props.description: Signature dual-bar kinetic plus/minus counter-rotating icon.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration (ms)
props.description: CSS Grid height and icon rotation transition speed in milliseconds.

components.name: Infinite Marquee
components.description: High-performance rAF continuous translation loop with modulo wrap, exponential hover damping, and zero external animation libraries.

props.name: speed
props.label: Scroll Speed (px/s)
props.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second.

props.name: direction
props.label: Direction
props.description: Direction of marquee translation.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.label: Pause On Hover
props.description: Smoothly decelerate to zero when hovered.

props.name: gap
props.label: Item Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between items and repeated tracks in pixels.

props.name: showFadeEdges
props.label: Fade Edges
props.description: Show subtle gradient mask at boundaries for graceful entry and exit.

props.name: fadeWidth
props.label: Fade Width (px)
props.description: Width of the edge gradient fade in pixels.

props.name: fadeEdgeColor
props.label: Fade Edge Color
props.description: Custom edge gradient color. When empty, an alpha mask is used.

props.name: fadeEdgeColorDark
props.label: Fade Edge Color (Dark Mode)
props.description: Edge gradient color when dark mode is active. Falls back to fadeEdgeColor.

components.name: Bento Grid
components.description: Fluid responsive layout engine with dense auto-flow, asymmetric card spans, and subtle kinetic hover glow.

props.name: cols
props.label: Columns
props.description: Maximum column count for desktop screens.

props.name: gap
props.label: Grid Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between bento tiles.

props.name: rowHeight
props.label: Row Height (px)
props.description: Base auto-rows track height for vertical spans.

components.name: Diamond Grid
components.description: Rhombic symmetrical diamond column distribution [1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 1] with container-query responsive collapse.

props.name: mode
props.label: Grid Mode
props.description: Visual rendering mode (classic upright cards in rhombic columns vs 45° tilted diamond cards).

props.name: gap
props.label: Column Gap
props.description: Spacing between diamond columns and elements in pixels.

props.name: layout
props.label: Layout Topology
props.description: Rhombic column layout topology (large: 7-col [1,2,3,4,3,2,1], medium: 5-col, small: 3-col).

props.name: responsive
props.label: Responsive Mobile Collapse
props.description: Enable collapse to compact grid on narrow mobile screens (< 420px). When disabled (default), preserves authentic rhombic diamond structure across all devices.

components.name: Border Beam
components.description: Zero-runtime CSS perimeter laser trace with hardware mask clipping and sub-pixel compositing.

props.name: size
props.label: Beam Length (px)
props.description: Length/size of the perimeter laser trace.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration (s)
props.description: Loop duration for one full border sweep.

props.name: borderWidth
props.label: Border Width (px)
props.description: Perimeter border stroke width.

props.name: colorFrom
props.label: Color From
props.description: Starting gradient color.

props.name: colorTo
props.label: Color To
props.description: Ending gradient color.

props.name: doubleBeam
props.label: Double Beam
props.description: Render a secondary beam located on the opposite side of the perimeter, orbiting in the same direction (180° phase offset).

props.name: endOpacity
props.label: End Opacity
props.description: Opacity of the beam tail at its trailing edge (0 for pure transparent).

props.name: opacity
props.label: Opacity
props.description: Overall opacity of the border beam trace.

props.name: blur
props.label: Glow Blur (px)
props.description: Specular diffuse blur applied to the perimeter laser trace.

props.name: borderRadius
props.label: Corner Radius (px)
props.description: Corner radius of the perimeter path matching card borders.

components.name: Floating Dock
components.description: High-performance kinetic floating application dock with continuous C1-cosine proximity distribution, multi-directional orientation, and zero layout thrashing.

props.name: direction
props.label: Dock Direction / Orientation
props.description: Orientation and shelf alignment edge of the dock and tooltip positions.

props.name: baseSize
props.label: Base Item Size (px)
props.description: Default width and height of dock items at rest.

props.name: maxMagnification
props.label: Max Boost Factor
props.description: Maximum scale multiplier at zero distance.

props.name: influenceRadius
props.label: Influence Radius (px)
props.description: Influence spread of the Gaussian proximity curve.

props.name: showLabels
props.label: Show App Labels
props.description: Display macOS-style frosted tooltips on icon hover/focus.

props.name: panelStyle
props.label: Dock Panel Style
props.description: Visual backing shelf styling of the dock.

components.name: Number Ticker
components.description: Analytical easeOutExpo numerical counter with direct DOM textContent manipulation and zero external animation libraries.

props.name: value
props.label: Target Value
props.description: The target numerical value to count towards.

props.name: initialValue
props.label: Initial Value
props.description: Starting number at inception.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration (s)
props.description: Time in seconds to reach the target number.

props.name: decimalPlaces
props.label: Decimals
props.description: Decimal precision to format.

props.name: prefix
props.label: Prefix
props.description: Leading currency or symbol (e.g. "$", "+", "€").

props.name: suffix
props.label: Suffix
props.description: Trailing unit identifier (e.g. "%", "ms", "k", "M").

components.name: Magnetic Button
components.description: Inverted spring pull field button that magnetically attracts cursor proximity with critically damped release snaps.

props.name: strength
props.label: Pull Strength
props.description: Displacement factor relative to cursor distance.

props.name: radius
props.label: Magnetic Radius (px)
props.description: Influence radius threshold in pixels.

props.name: springDamping
props.label: Spring Damping
props.description: Exponential decay rate for critically damped snaps.

components.name: Card Swipe Stack
components.description: Velocity-sensitive multi-card swipe stack with Euler angular rotation, circular velocity ring buffer, elastic last-card resistance, and zero external animation libraries.

props.name: thresholdDistance
props.label: Swipe Threshold (px)
props.description: Minimum drag distance to trigger a card dismiss.

props.name: maxRotation
props.label: Max Rotation (deg)
props.description: Maximum angular rotation coupled to horizontal translation.

props.name: scaleStep
props.label: Scale Step
props.description: Scale reduction step between consecutive cards in the stack.

props.name: offsetStep
props.label: Offset Step (px)
props.description: Vertical offset in pixels between consecutive cards in the stack.

props.name: preventLastCardDismiss
props.label: Anchor Last Card
props.description: When enabled, the final card cannot be dismissed. Dragging it applies elastic rubber-band resistance and it snaps back to center on release.

components.name: Comparison Slider
components.description: Interactive before/after media comparison slider with sub-pixel clip-path polygon slicing and WAI-ARIA keyboard navigation.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.label: Default Position
props.description: Initial divider split ratio between 0 and 1.

props.name: step
props.label: Keyboard Step
props.description: Position delta when stepping with arrow keys.

props.name: orientation
props.label: Orientation
props.description: Slider split direction (horizontal or vertical).

components.name: Expandable Card
components.description: Mathematical FLIP morphing card dialog with zero Framer Motion dependencies, zero layout shifts, and accessible dialog semantics.

props.name: duration
props.label: Morph Duration (ms)
props.description: FLIP transition timing in milliseconds.

components.name: Cursor Tooltip
components.description: Tactile cursor-following tooltip with continuous exponential lerp tracking, boundary viewport collision clamping, and zero Framer Motion dependencies.

props.name: springDamping
